"Testing
Build generation
If the game maker has limited development capacity, prioritize a complete playable single-player game over partially implemented multiplayer features.
34. FINAL DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS
Deliver an actual playable game.
I expect:
A working game build.
A complete project source.
A functioning main menu.
A playable character.
A real combat system.
Infinite leveling.
A functioning skill-point system.
Working skill trees.
A world exploration system.
Procedural content generation.
An AI Game Master integration where supported.
Persistent player saves.
A shadow army.
Class evolution.
Dungeons and world bosses.
A quest system.
A guild system.
A working administrator cheat panel.
Mobile controls.
Documentation for installation and configuration.
The game must launch without requiring me to manually write code.
If external AI APIs or backend services are required, provide clear setup instructions and secure configuration.
Do not claim that the AI is connected if it is not.
Do not claim that the game is complete if major features are only mockups.
Provide a playable build as soon as the foundation is complete, then continue implementing the remaining systems.
FINAL CREATIVE DIRECTION
I want this to feel like an anime where I am the main character, but I am not restricted to a predetermined story.
I want freedom.
I want to explore.
I want to become powerful.
I want to build an army.
I want to discover secret classes.
I want to create a guild.
I want to conquer dungeons.
I want to fight enemies that evolve alongside my progression.
I want the world to remember what I have done.
I want the AI to introduce situations I could never predict.
I want to have the ability to become absurdly powerful through the administrator system if I choose.
I want to be able to play for hundreds or thousands of hours without reaching a mandatory ending.
The game should feel like a living anime universe that continues to expand.
THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: THERE MUST ALWAYS BE SOMETHING NEW TO DISCOVER, SOMETHING NEW TO ACHIEVE, OR SOMETHING NEW TO BECOME.
Build SHADOW SYSTEM ∞: THE ETERNAL MONARCH.
The world is mine to conquer.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
